objective: Certificar en modo READ_ONLY el Scope Fix R2B ya integrado para Cavas Gate 12N. Verificar que el cambio de _resolve_cava_scope usa el UnidadNegocioID UUID autorizado como scope operativo, que las pruebas de Cavas/Persona-Link pasan, que el candidato UAT SOC-00001 permanece limpio y que no existen residuos antes de habilitar UAT R2. No modificar archivos, datos, RBAC, permisos, usuarios, empresas, unidades ni Produccion.

queries.name: gate12n_r2b_candidate_clean
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) AS UnidadNegocioID,PersonaID,ClienteCRMID FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C');

queries.name: gate12n_r2b_baseline_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona) AS total_personas,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo) AS total_vinculos,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE PersonaID IS NOT NULL) AS socios_vinculados;

constraints: No UAT execution in this job
Do not change permissions roles users menus units or companies
EDARSAHUB SQL Server remains source of truth
Certification must fail closed on any blocker or residue
